invariants: staffId and serviceId must be positive integers.

startTime must be the strict canonical UTC form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:00.000Z for a real calendar date; numeric timezone offsets, missing or non-Z timezone markers, non-canonical fractional seconds, non-ISO strings and unreal dates are rejected.
startTime must fall exactly on a 30-minute boundary (minutes 00 or 30, zero seconds and milliseconds).
All failures throw BookingValidationError with code BOOKING_VALIDATION_ERROR.
